g.title: cluster_rdrs
g.text: RDRS sync loop (runs in every cluster)

g.title: sync
g.text: 1 read group tables over the metadata connection
2 expand Who × What into account names and (db, table) keys
3 keep groups whose data this cluster hosts, plus ALL groups
4 percent → rate using this cluster's thread count
5 USER SET / ALTER / DROP per group
6 USER ALIAS SET / DROP per account
